text:
Alex H: paging — we’re seeing a spike in notification failures for both SMS and email across eu-west-1 and eu-central. digests show a spike at ~08:12 UTC. Twilio errors 523/rate-limit and SMTP 421 transient rejects from SendGrid.
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-1775001234 (sev-2) — customer notifications degraded. Paging on-call.
Maria G: seeing retries piling up in the notification worker queue, approx 30% of SMS attempts failing and ~12% email bounces/temporary rejects. signups + 2FA flows affected.
Samir K: I'm on-call, taking lead. @Maria can you paste a quick query with top error messages and client impact breakdown?
Maria G: sure — query results: "twilio: 523 rate limit", "twilio: 429 too many requests" (sms europe), "sendgrid: 421 try again later" (esp eu pool). Top affected customers are onboarding flows and password resets.
Julia P: adding context — we see increased latency from our outbound proxy to SendGrid IPs, connection resets. traces show a spike in outbound TCP retries.
Erin L: starting live mitigations: 1) increase retry delay to exponential backoff (to reduce hammering), 2) enable failover routing for emails to Mailgun for eu region, 3) flip SMS to backup provider (MessageBird) for eu prefixes. deploying now.
Samir K: good. Maria/Julia please open vendor support tickets and request urgency escalation. Share ticket IDs here.
Maria G: SendGrid case opened: 789201 — support replied: investigating throttling on eu pool, advising reduced send-rate. Twilio case: 445612 — reporting elevated rate-limited responses from their EU edge.
ops-bot: Deploy started by Erin L: feature/notifications/failover-toggle -> staging -> prod (canary 10%).
Alex H: FYI — toggles are in feature flags console under notifications.failover.eu, toggle to "on" to route to backups. Use sticky_control header for overrides.
Julia P: rolling the email failover to Mailgun canary 10% succeeded. Monitoring for delivery latency and bounce rates.
Erin L: SMS reroute to MessageBird applied to 30% of EU traffic. initial success: message queue drain rate improved by ~18% on canary.
Support Rotation: support escalation: shared status update to customers via status.redwood.ai — message: "We are investigating delivery delays for SMS and email in EU regions. Some verification and notification flows may be delayed. Working with providers; mitigations in progress."
Samir K: cross-check: are verification tokens vulnerable to duplicate sends if we retry? Maria: we’ve added idempotency key check in workers — double-sends suppressed for 24h.
Maria G: note about metrics — the notification failure dashboard updated with a temporary panel for vendor 5xx/4xx splits and backup provider success rate. Will keep watchers on.
Alex H: Ops ask: reduce concurrency from 50 -> 10 for the outbound workers in eu to avoid exacerbating vendor throttles. Julia, can you apply autoscale override?
Julia P: done. concurrency reduced. workers reporting fewer immediate 429s.
incidents-bot: Handoff initiated — Samir K -> Maria G at 08:40 UTC for extended mitigation and vendor comms.
Samir K: moving to coordination only. Maria, you have the lead. I’ll keep pager watch for regressions.
Maria G: taking lead. Next steps: 1) keep failover enabled until Twilio/SendGrid confirm full recovery, 2) continue vendor comms and request post-incident rate limit increases, 3) coordinate status updates (every 30m) and draft RCA owner. Proposing postmortem owner: Julia P.
Erin L: do we want to throttle non-critical notification categories (marketing/outbound) to preserve transactional messages? I can apply priority filters.
Maria G: yes pause marketing sends in eu and global non-urgent batches. Alex please confirm policy blocklist for campaign sends.
Alex H: done — campaign_send queue paused for eu region and global queued campaigns suspended.
Support Rotation: posted update to customers (08:55 UTC): "Mitigations in place; backup providers routing enabled. Some customers may still see delays — we will post next update at 09:25 UTC."
Maria G: monitoring shows success rate for verification SMS increased from 70% -> 92% on canary after reroute. Email deliveries to Mailgun showing increased latency but delivering.
Julia P: vendor updates: SendGrid initial mitigation in progress, they flagged a transient infrastructure issue in their EU pool. Twilio reports edge rate-limiting and asked to reduce burst traffic. Both vendors requested we lower concurrency while they finish remediation.
Samir K: classification check — Sev2 due to customer-visible auth/verification impact. P0 steps only if payments impacted.
Alex H: post-incident action items (RCA): 1) add multi-provider auto-failover runbook (owner: Julia P), 2) implement per-customer backoff policy and token-safe retries (owner: Maria G), 3) add synthetic end-to-end checks for EU SMS+Email (owner: Erin L), 4) update SLAs and playbooks for vendor rate-limits (owner: Alex H).
Maria G: assigning follow-ups in issues board now. Drafting incident timeline.
incidents-bot: Incident INC-1775001234 severity lowered to Sev-3 at 09:10 UTC — delivery rates restored >95% with mitigations.
Support Rotation: final customer update (09:15 UTC): "Deliveries restored and backup routing remains enabled while vendors complete their remediation. We will follow up with an incident report." :white_check_mark:
Samir K: thanks team. I’ll wait 30min to ensure stability then sign off on on-call.
Maria G: handoff to Samir for final monitoring at 09:40 UTC. Postmortem owner: Julia P. ETA for complete RCA draft: 72 hours.
Alex H: logging note — attach this thread to the incident ticket and to the postmortem doc in /incidents/rca.
Julia P: filing RCA outline now.
Erin L: deploying a synthetic check for EU flows in next 2 hours.
Alex H: closing loop — great job on quick failover and clear vendor comms.
Samir K: closing watch. Feel free to ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
